s: Din arba reshuyyot leshabbat ubo k"z seipim: arba reshuyyot leshabbat: reshut hayyachid ureshut harabbim, karmelit umeqom petur. Ezo hi reshut hayyachid? Maqom hammuqqap mechitztzot gebohot asara tepachim, veyesh bachalalo d' tepachim al d' tepachim, shezzehu shiur maqom chashub harauy lehishtammesh bo. Veken charitz amoq asara tepachim, shennimtza chalalo muqqap bimchitztzot gebohot asara, im rochab chalalo hu d' tepachim al d' tepachim, shehu shiur maqom — hare hu reshut hayyachid gemura betoko, apillu hu birshut harabbim. Veken ammud o tel shehu gaboah asara verachab d' al d' — hare hu kemuqqap mechitztzot gebohot asara, shehalaka lemosheh missinay hi sheanu omerim "gud asseq", dehaynu sheanu roim et d' tzedade haammud haggebohim y' tepachim keillu nimsheku vehualu lemala al rosho veomedim kimchitztzot sabib lo, venimtza rosho muqqap mid' tzedadim vachalalo d' al d':

Tel shehu meshuppa veholek umitlaqqet begobho meat meat, im hu magbiah y' tepachim mittok hilluk d' ammot — hare hu keillu zaqup beyosher, ureshut hayyachid hu bimqom gobho, im magbiah ken mikkol ruchotayv, apillu hu omed birshut harabbim, kevan sheen noach lahalok bo. Abal im mitlaqqet gobah asara mittok hilluk h' ammot, hare hahilluk bo noach veqal, ulepikak hu kirshut harabbim gemura im hu birshut harabbim, o kekarmelit im hu bekarmelit:

Ammud gaboah asara sheyyesh berosho d' al d', umitqatztzer veholek lematta, ukeshemmaggia g' tepachim samuk laaretz yesh bo g' tepachim al g' tepachim — hare hu reshut hayyachid al rosho, lepi shehalaka lemosheh missinay hi sheomerim "gud achet", dehaynu, meshok et rosh haammud mikkol tzedadayv vehored lematta ad laaretz, vahare zeh keillu mechitztzot maqqipot oto mikkol tzedadayv ad rosho; vekevan shebberosho yesh d' al d', hare hu sham reshut hayyachid gemura. Vaapillu im keshehiggia lepachot mig' tepachim samuk laaretz en beobyo g' tepachim al g' tepachim, en bekak kelum, shekkol shehu pachot mig' tepachim laaretz kelabud hu, ukeillu higgia laaretz. Abal tachat rosho vead haaretz, ap al pi sheanu roim keillu mechitztzot maqqipot sham — en zeh moil laasot sham reshut hayyachid, lepi sheen sham revach d' al d' sheyyehe rauy lehishtammesh sham, shehare tachtit haammud mapsiq sham:

Ammud sheyyesh beobyo d' al d' bemeshek gobah asara, veachar kak mitmaet veholek, ap al pi shekkeshemmaggia leg' tepachim samuk laaretz en beobyo g' tepachim, o apillu im kebar en beobyo g' tepachim lemala harbeh yoter mig' tepachim samuk laaretz — hare hu reshut hayyachid al gabbah, mishshum sheomerim gud asseq gobah y' tepachim shel tzedadayv lemala, kemo shennitbaer. Abal lematta tachat hashshippua eno reshut hayyachid, kevan shei epshar lomar sham "gud achet", mechamat beqiat haggedayim, ki kol mechitztza sheeno maggaat g' tepachim laaretz eno mechitztza lachaloq reshut bipne atzmah, lepi shehaggedayim yekolim libqoa tachteha. Abal pachot mig' tepachim, sheenan yekolin laabor sham, apillu en bah ella z' tepachim umashshehu — anu omerim labud, ukeillu higgia laaretz:

Kol maqom sheyyesh lo sham d' mechitztzot, ap al pi sheenan shelemot ella perutzot beemtzaan, veen bahen ella amma lekan veamma lekan bekol zavit, kegon d' qorot hanneutzim birshut harabbim learba zaviyyot, vekol achat obyah amma al amma, shennimtza shellekol ruach yesh mechitztza berochab amma mizzavit zo uberochab amma mizzavit zo, im en benehem ella y"g ammot ushelish — hare zeh reshut hayyachid min hattora, vehazzoreq letokah mereshut harabbim chayyab. Abal middibre soperim enan chashubot mechitztzot lehattir hattiltul betoko, apillu hen bekarmelit, hoil vehapparutz merubbeh al haomed, ella leole regalim bilbad hittiru laasot ken sabib habberaot shebbirshut harabbim, kede sheyyihyu mayim metzuyim lahem beshabbatot:

Veken maqom hammuqqap g' mechitztzot gemurot ella shepparutz upatuach legamre beruach rebiit, o apillu en bo ella b' mechitztzot velechi, shellechi zeh niddon kimchitztza g', al derek sheyyitbaer besimman shs"g — hare hu reshut hayyachid gemura min hattora, vehazzoreq mereshut harabbim letoko chayyab. Abal chakamim aseru letaltel bo yoter mid' ammot, veshello lehotzi ulehaknis mittoko lirshut hayyachid velo lirshut harabbim, kedin hakkarmelit sheyyitbaer. Bammeh debarim amurim? Keshemmaqom zeh hu parutz upatuach lekarmelit. Abal im hu patuach lirshut harabbim — hazzoreq letoko patur, sheeno kirshut hayyachid min hattora, mippene shellipamim nidchaqim rabbim letoko, kesheyyesh dochaq rab birshut harabbim:

Ketalim hammaqqipim et reshut hayyachid — hare al gabbehem reshut hayyachid, ap al pi sheenan rechabim d'. Vaapillu im gam hechalal shebbenehem en bo d', sheeno reshut hayyachid sham, mikkol maqom al gabbe hakketalim lemala, im yesh sham d' al d' behitztorput kullam im hechalal shebbenehem — hare hu reshut hayyachid sham. Veap al pi sheeno rauy lehishtammesh sham al gabbe ketalim, sheen bahem rochab d' bekol echad, mikkol maqom hare epshar lehanniach sham al gabbehem dap harachab d' al d', kemiddatam im hechalal shebbenehem, ulehishtammesh alayv:

Chorim shebbekotle reshut hayyachid shekkelappe reshut hayyachid, hem reshut hayyachid. Vaapillu hem mepullashim kelappe chutz lirshut harabbim, vehem lematta mi' tepachim sheshsham hu avir reshut harabbim, ubene reshut harabbim mishtammeshim bahem, ap al pi ken kevan sheepshar lehishtammesh bahem mereshut hayyachid — hare hem betelim etzlah venechshabim kamoha. Abal im hem kelappe chutz veenam oberim kelappe penim, enam betelim etzlah, vahare hem niddonim lepi gobham verochbam kemo sheyyitbaer:

Avir reshut hayyachid hu reshut hayyachid ad laraqia. Velaken im naatz qaneh birshut hayyachid, apillu gaboah mea amma, al gabbayv reshut hayyachid. Veken kol mah sheyyesh birshut hayyachid, ben rachab ben qatzar ben gaboah ben namuk, dino kirshut hayyachid, shekken derek libnot birshut hayyachid aliyyot zo lemala mizzo, qetannot ugedolot:

Vaapillu keli haomed birshut harabbim, im yesh bo kede lerabbea d' tepachim al d' tepachim vehu gaboah y' tepachim, kegon teba o kavveret o migdal, hare hu reshut hayyachid betoko veal gabbo ad laraqia, mippene shekkol shehu gaboah asara verachab d' hu choleq reshut leatzmo. Abal im eno gaboah asara, ap al pi sherachab d', eno choleq reshut leatzmo. Veap al pi shechakamim gazeru al kol dabar sherachab d' veeno gaboah asara laasoto reshut bipne atzmo, dehaynu karmelit kemo sheyyitbaer, mikkol maqom bekelim lo ratzu chakamim ligzor lebattelam mittorat keli laasotam reshut bipne atzmam, hoil vehen kelim, vedinam kimqom petur. Veyesh omerim sheddinam kirshut harabbim shehem omedim aleha, vekol shekken im eno rachab d' vehu lematta mi'. Vekelim hammechubbarim laqqarqa en alehem torat keli leinyan zeh, vegazeru alehem laasotam karmelit im rechabim d' veenam gebohim y':

Ezo hi reshut harabbim? Rechobot ushevaqim harechabim t"z amma al t"z amma, shekken haya rochab hadderek bemachaneh leviyyim shebbammidbar. Vehu sheenam meqorim veen lahem choma sabib. Vaapillu yesh lahem choma ella shehem mepullashim mishshaar leshaar, dehaynu shehashshearim mekuvvanim zeh keneged zeh, hare yesh leoto derek hammekuvvan mishshaar leshaar kol din reshut harabbim im hu rachab t"z amma, shehare en lo ella b' mechitztzot mishshene tzedadayv bilbad (im mechitztzot ellu enan rechoqot amma berochab reshut harabbim mikkeneged chalal hashshaar). Vehu sheen haddelatot ninalot ballayla, kemo sheyyitbaer besimman shs"d. Veken derakim sheoberim bahen meir leir urechabim t"z amma, veken meboot rechabim t"z amma hammepullashim merechob lirchob o merechobot lidrakim harechabim t"z amma, hen reshut harabbim gemura. Veyesh omerim shekkol sheen shishshim ribbo oberim bo bekol yom kedigle midbar, eno reshut harabbim ella karmelit. Veal pi dibrehem nitpashshet hamminhag bimdinot ellu lehaqel velomar sheen lanu akshav reshut harabbim gemura, veen limchot beyadam, sheyyesh lahem al mi sheyyismeku (vekol yere shamayim yachmir leatzmo):

Meboot harechabim t"z amma, apillu shemmitqatztzerim biqtzatan veen bahem t"z amma — hare hen reshut harabbim, lepi shei epshar lirshut harabbim lehitlaqqet bimlaqqet urehiteni. Lepikak meboot hammepullashim lirshut harabbim mib' rashehem, veorkan leorek reshut harabbim, ap al pi sheen berochban t"z amma — hare hem reshut harabbim gemura, lepi shehen kirshut harabbim arukka shennitqatztzera biqtzatah, kevan sheorkan leorek reshut harabbim. Abal im orkan mepullash lerochab reshut harabbim, enan reshut harabbim. Veyesh omerim sheenan reshut harabbim ella im ken rechabim y"g amma ushelish (veaz hem reshut harabbim apillu hem mepullashim lerochab reshut harabbim), ukebar nitbaer sheakshav yesh omerim sheen lanu reshut harabbim bekol inyan:

Kol dabar shehu birshut harabbim, im eno gaboah g' tepachim, apillu hem qotzim o tzoa sheen rabbim doresim alehem — chashubim kaqqarqa, vahare hem reshut harabbim (vaapillu hem kelim). Veim hu gaboah g' umig' vead t' velo t' biklal, im hu rachab d' al d' — chalaq reshut leatzmo middibre soperim vehu kekarmelit, vehu sheeno keli. Veim eno rachab d' al d', hu meqom petur (veim hu keli, nitbaer leel). Veim hu gaboah t' tepachim metzumtzamim, sherauy lekattep alayv, sheeno lo gaboah velo namuk, verabbim mekattepim alayv — hare hu kirshut harabbim gemura apillu eno rochab d', shekkevan shehu tzarik larabbim, reshut harabbim hu, ben rachab ben qatzar. Abal im en rabbim mekattepim alayv, ap al pi sherauy hu lekattep alayv — eno reshut harabbim. Upachot mit', apillu im mekattepim alayv eno kelum, mippene sheeno rauy lekittup. Veyesh omerim shemit' vead asara rauy hu lekittup, ureshut harabbim hu im mekattepim alayv, apillu eno rochab d'. Abal measara ulemala, ap im rauy hu lekittup umekattepim alayv — hare nishtanna lirshut acheret, sheim hu rachab d' al d' hu reshut hayyachid, veim eno rachab d' hu meqom petur (apillu hu keli). Vaapillu yesh bo maqom kede lachoq lehashlimo led', kegon chor shebbakkotel kelappe reshut harabbim vehu gaboah asara, veen betoko d' al d', hare hu meqom petur, veen omerim roim keillu nechqaq min hakkotel bimqomo keshiur d' al d':

Guma birshut harabbim, im enah amuqqa g' tepachim — hare hu reshut harabbim. Mishshelosha vead asara — im rechaba d' al d' hare hu karmelit, veim lav hu meqom petur, apillu hi amuqqa asara tepachim veyoter. Vaapillu im lipamim mannichim bah rabbim cheptzehem ad sheyyashubu, mikkol maqom tashmish al yede haddechaq hu, veeno chashub tashmish laasotah reshut harabbim bishbil kak. Veim hi amuqqa asara urechaba arbaa — hare zo reshut hayyachid, shehare yesh lah mechitztzot betokah. Vehu sheyyehe haomeq asara mitlaqqet mittok hilluk d' ammot:

Hayeta hagguma melea mayim — en hammayim mebattelim hammechitztzot, vehu haddin shear debarim tzelulim sheadam mistakkel bahem veroeh betokam venirim hammechitztzot. Abal melea perot enah reshut hayyachid, shehapperot mebattelim hammechitztzot min hattora, apillu dato lepannotam hayyom, hoil veakshav en hammechitztzot nikkarot. (Vaapillu bimlea mayim, o apillu bereqanit, enah reshut hayyachid ella im ken haomeq asara hu mitlaqqet mittok hilluk d' ammot, kemo shennitbaer lemala. (Vaapillu hu amoq asara mittok hilluk d' ammot), eno reshut hayyachid (middibre soperim) ella karmelit, kemo hayyammim vehannechalim sheenan reshut hayyachid middibre soperim apillu amuqqim asara mittok hilluk d' ammot, hoil veoberim alehem, kemo sheyyitbaer). Vehu haddin lirqaq shebbekarmelit. (Veen tzarik lomar im hu amoq asara mittok hilluk yoter mid' ammot, sheaz eno reshut hayyachid min hattora, veap al pi ken eno reshut harabbim, ap al pi sheharabbim mehallekim bo, lepi shekkol mayim shehen amuqqim asara en noach lahalok bahen kelal):

Reqaq mayim shebbirshut harabbim sheeno amoq asara, batel hu lagaby reshut harabbim im regilim harabbim lehallek bo, ap al pi shehu hilluk sheal yede haddechaq. Vaapillu im eno rachab d', sheen mehallekim betoko ella medallegim alayv — hare hu reshut harabbim, kevan sheharabbim boqeim bo veoberim alayv, veen maqqipim oto kemo shemmaqqipim et habbor shebbirshut harabbim. Veken dap hammunnach al gabbe hareqaq (o al habbor) hu reshut harabbim, kevan sherabbim boqeim bo. Abal reqaq sheen rabbim boqeim bo eno reshut harabbim, ap al pi sheeno amoq asara, ella karmelit hu im hu rachab d', vaapillu hu amoq t':

Avir reshut harabbim eno reshut harabbim ella ad asara tepachim. Abal lemala mi' tepachim meqom petur hu leinyan dabar sheeno mesuyyam, kegon pene kotel shebbirshut harabbim, im ezeh dabar nidbaq sham o qolet min haavir — muttar lehotzi mishsham lirshut hayyachid. Abal dabar mesuyyam, kegon chor shebbakkotel o rosh ammud, im en bo d' al d' — apillu lematta measara meqom petur hu, veim yesh bo d' al d' — gam lemala measara eno meqom petur, ella reshut hayyachid gemura hu:

Chorim shebbakketalim kelappe reshut harabbim veenam mepullashim lipnim, im hem (rachabim) [gebohim] g' tepachim enam kirshut harabbim, ella niddonim lepi middotehem: im yesh bahem d' al d' vehem lematta my' tepachim — hem karmelit, veim hem lemala mi' tepachim — hem reshut hayyachid, veim en bahem d' al d' — hem meqom petur, ben shehem lemala measara ben shehem lematta measara:

Ezo hi karmelit? Maqom sheeno hilluk larabbim vegam eno muqqap mechitztzot kehilkatan. Vezehu "kearmelit", kelomar kealmana sheenah lo betula velo nesua, kak zeh eno muqqap mechitztzot kirshut hayyachid veeno hilluk lerabbim kirshut harabbim. Umaqom zeh hu meqom petur min hattora, shemmuttar lehotzi ulehaknis mittoko lirshut hayyachid velirshut harabbim umehem letoko, mippene shehu batel etzel kol echad mehen, ben sheyyesh bo d' ben sheen bo. Ella shechakamim chillequ benehem, shekkesheen bo d' al d' hu meqom petur, ukesheyyesh bo — hu maqom chashub veeno batel etzlan, vaasauhu reshut bipne atzmo uqerauhu karmelit. Kegon maqom sheyyesh bo d' al d' hammuqqap mechitztzot sheenan gebohot y' tepachim, veken tel o ammud sheyyesh bo d' al d' veeno gaboah asara, veken charitz sheyyesh bo d' al d' veeno amoq asara. Veken hayyammim vehannechalim, sheap shehem amuqqim asara vehammayim enam mebattelim hammechitztzot, mikkol maqom en haomeq asara mitlaqqet mittok hilluk d' ammot, vegam enan reshut harabbim, ap al pi sherabbim mehallekim bahem bispinot, lepi sheeno noach tashmish halikatan kemo bayyabbasha, veeno domeh ledigle midbar. Veap im yesh bahem guma sheomqah mitlaqqet y' tepachim mittok hilluk d' ammot, shehi reshut hayyachid gemura min hattora, vehazzoreq letokah mereshut harabbim chayyab, mikkol maqom middibre soperim enah reshut hayyachid ella karmelit (hoil veoberim al mechitztzoteha milmala keillu lo hayu sham mechitztzot kelal):

Veken habbiqa, dehaynu sadot zeruot o qetzurot sheenan muqqapot gader gaboah y' tepachim, veken qeren zavit hassemuka lirshut harabbim, kegon meboot sheyyesh lahem g' mechitztzot veen lahem lechi o qora beruach rebiit happetucha lirshut harabbim, veken reshut harabbim shehi meqora, sheenah doma ledigle midbar — hen karmelit:

Veken haistevanit, dehaynu maqom panuy shellipne hachanuyot sheyyoshebim sham hassocharim al itztebaot, umaqom zeh eno asuy lehilluk rabbim, vekarmelit hu. Veken haammudim shebbirshut harabbim shebbahem tolim hattaggarim peraqmatya, vegam itztebaot sedurot lipnehem lesheb sham hattaggarim, hare itztebaot ellu hen karmelit im hen rechabot d' al d' ugebohot mishshelosha vead asara, kemo shennitbaer leel betel veammud shebbirshut harabbim. Abal maqom panuy shebben haammudim hu reshut harabbim, kevan sherabbim boqeim sham. Veap al pi shebben ammud leammud en sham rochab t"z amma keshiur rochab reshut harabbim, vaapillu en sham apillu y"g amma ushelish keshiur mabuy hammepullash mereshut harabbim, ap al pi ken kevan sherabbim boqeim bahem — hem tepelim lirshut harabbim harechaba t"z amma. Mah sheen ken bemaboy, shehu maqom chashub bipne atzmo veeno tapel ubatel lirshut harabbim:

Bayit namuk, sheen toko y' tepachim begobah veqeruyo mashlimo laasara, im yesh bo d' al d' — hare al gabbayv reshut hayyachid, kemo al gabbe ammud haggaboah asara verachab d', mishshum "gud asseq". Abal toko hu karmelit, kevan sheen sham mechitztzot gebohot asara. Veim choqeq bahem d' al d', apillu baemtza, rachoq min hakketalim g' tepachim o yoter — naasa kullo reshut hayyachid, lepi shebbimqom hachaqaq atzmo, sheshsham hu gaboah asara, sham hu reshut hayyachid gemura; vehashshear naasa kechore reshut hayyachid shehem kirshut hayyachid. Veap al pi shessepat hachaqaq mitztarep im hakketalim shebbetoko lehashlimam laasara, ap al pi shehu rachoq mehem g' tepachim o yoter, mikkol maqom al yede tzad hachitzon shel hakketalim, sheshsham hem gebohim y', naasa chaqaq zeh reshut hayyachid, hoil veyesh bo chalal gaboah y' tepachim. Veap al pi shehakketalim rechoqim mechalalo g' tepachim o yoter, en bekak kelum, lepi shelleinyan shabbat en tzarik raq shettehe hareshut mishtammeret al yede hammechitztzot, vaapillu hen rechoqot mimmenna harbeh niqret reshut hayyachid, vehashshear naasa kechore reshut hayyachid shehem kirshut hayyachid. Abal keshello chaqaq bo, en toko naaseh reshut hayyachid al yede tzad hachitzon shel hakketalim, hoil veen betoko chalal gaboah y' tepachim. Veim en hakketalim gebohim asara apillu betzad hachitzon shellahem, en hachaqaq naaseh reshut hayyachid, ella im ken hu samuk lakketalim pachot mig' tepachim, sheaz mitztarep sepato legobah hakketalim lehashlimam laasara, veap al pi sheen hakketalim gebohim y' apillu betzad hachitzon, mikkol maqom mitztorpim:

Gag habbolet al mechitztzot habbayit, beinyan sheen mechitztzot habbayit nikkarim venirim laomedim al haggag keshemmistakkelin tachat raglehem, kegon gaggin shellanu — en omerim bimchitztzot ellu "gud asseq", velaken al gabbe haggag eno reshut hayyachid apillu hu gaboah verachab harbeh, ella karmelit hu. Veim challon patuach lo min habbayit, naasa kullo kechore reshut hayyachid, ureshut hayyachid hu. Veken zizin habboletim min hakkotel veyesh bahem d' al d', hem karmelit, ella im ken challon habbayit patuach lahem, lepi sheap shehem gebohim asara, en omerim bahem "gud achet mechitztza lematta ad laaretz", hoil vehaggedayim yekolim libqoa tachtehem, kemo shennitbaer lemala. Veyesh mi sheomer sheggag habbolet eno kekarmelit, ella im ken bolet d' tepachim letok reshut harabbim o karmelit, sheaz belita zo hi karmelit kemo zizim habboletim, ushear haggag hu parutz bemilluo liblita zo, shemmechitztzot habbayit en omerim bahem "gud asseq" lehapsiq ben belita zo lishar haggag, hoil veenan nikkarot lemi sheomed al haggag. Abal im en bablita d' tepachim, enah kekarmelit ella meqom petur, ushear haggag, ap al pi sheen lo ella mechitztzot habbayit veen omerim bahem "gud asseq", mikkol maqom kevan shehabbayit shettachtayv reshut hayyachid, hare reshut hayyachid ola ad laraqia; velo hutzreku lomar "gud asseq" ella bedabar shettachtayv eno reshut hayyachid gemura beheqqep mechitztzot sebibah, kegon ammud birshut harabbim vekayyotze bah (ella shekkevan sheshshear haggag parutz bemilluo labbelita shehi meqom petur, ap hu naasa meqom petur im habbelita hi meqom petur mib' ruchot haggag, kegon shershut harabbim o karmelit mehalleket mib' ruchot habbayit, sheggag zeh lo adip mibbayit shennipratz bemilluo mib' ruchotayv, sheeno reshut hayyachid ella korshut shennipratz lo). Veyesh lismok al debarayv lehaqel bedibre soperim:
(Chorim shebbakketalim kelappe karmelit, enam kekarmelit im hem lemala mig' tepachim, ella im ken yesh bahem d' al d' vehem lematta measara, kemo shennitbaer bechore reshut harabbim):

Karmelit — heqellu bah miqqulle reshut hayyachid umiqqulle reshut harabbim. Miqqule reshut hayyachid — sheen karmelit bepachot mid' al d', umiqqulle reshut harabbim — sheen karmelit lemala measara, ella meqom petur hu leinyan dabar sheeno mesuyyam, kemo shennitbaer birshut harabbim. Abal dabar mesuyyam, kegon rosh ammud haomed bekarmelit, im yesh bo d' al d' — reshut hayyachid hu, veim en bo d' al d' — ap lematta measara eno karmelit, ella meqom petur. Veyesh omerim sheen meqom petur bekarmelit ella birshut harabbim, abal bekarmelit anu omerim "matza min et mino veneor", dehaynu, hammeqom petur matza et hakkarmelit shehi mino, shehi gam ken meqom petur min hattora, veneor venitchazzeq al yede mino lehitztarep immo velihyot kamohu. Velaken kol dabar sheen bo d' al d', sheeno choleq reshut leatzmo, batel hu etzel hakkarmelit venaasa kamoha im hu lematta measara, abal im hu lemala measara meqom petur hu, sheen karmelit topeset lemala measara. Abal bor haomed bekarmelit, apillu amoq mea amma hu karmelit, ella im ken yesh bo d' al d', shehakkarmelit topeset ad hattehom veen meqom petur noheg sham. Veken iqqar. Uledibre hakkol en meqom petur birshut hayyachid, ella kol mah sheyyesh birshut hayyachid hu reshut hayyachid:

Bayyammim unechalim modedim ellu haasara tepachim shel karmelit meal pene hammayim velo min haqqarqa, lepi shehammayim nechshabim kaaretz atzmah. Velaken kol hammayim vey' tepachim lemala al pene hammayim hem karmelit, lemala measara hu meqom petur:

Ezehu meqom petur? Kol maqom gaboah shebbirshut harabbim sheen bo d' al d' vehu gaboah mishshelosha ulemala ad laraqia, o charitz sheen bo d' tepachim rochab veamoq mishshelosha vead hattehom, apillu hu arok elep amma. Veken mechitztzot haggebohot mishshelosha vead laraqia veen benehem d' al d' — hare benehem meqom petur im hem birshut harabbim.
